new_rows.program_name: Ford Foundation Fellowship Program (predoctoral, dissertation, postdoctoral)
new_rows.funder: Ford Foundation / National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
new_rows.stated_purpose: Sought to increase the diversity of the nation's college and university faculties, maximize the educational benefits of diversity, and increase the number of professors able to use diversity as a resource for enriching the education of all students.
new_rows.eligibility_notes: Historical eligibility not re-verified: the programme is closed to new applicants, so the gate columns describe what it was, not what anyone can apply to now.
new_rows.status_evidence: Ford Foundation: 'we would wind down the Ford Fellowships program by 2028, and we began working with the National Academies to put a sunset plan in place.' Last new fellowships awarded in 2024; existing fellows supported through the end of their terms.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-17 (P1 F-005) as an informative absence. valid_to is the last year new awards were made (2024); the programme fully sunsets in 2028 as current fellows finish. Under the v0.1 schema the only way to represent this was omission, which reads identically to never having researched it.
